# OhMyPos

> Modern Point of Sale and back-office management system designed for multi-branch F&B businesses.

- [Login](/login): Authentication portal for Cashiers, Admins, and Owners.
- [POS Terminal](/sales): Front-of-house point of sale with real-time cart and inventory check.
- [Back Office Master Data](/master-data): Raw materials, products, and recipe configuration.
- [Inventory & Expenses](/inventory): Stock management, supplier purchases, and branch expenses.
- [Reconciliation](/reconciliation): Bank statement transaction matching and ledger allocation.
